caption:
Claude is a video editor now.  The setup is called Remotion. 

Install Claude Code. Add the plugin. One command. Then upload your video. Describe the edit you want. Cuts. Zooms. Captions. Headlines. Graphics. Claude writes the code. Builds everything automatically. 

And the best part? Want to change something? Don't open a timeline. Just tell Claude. "Change the colour to black and white" "Add a headline at 0:08" "Make the transition faster" It updates. Rebuilds. Done. . 

What video editors charge ₹5,000 and 3 hours for. Claude does it while you type a sentence. 
. 
Comment 'BUILD' 👇 I'll DM you the full setup guide. 
.
